## What changed

Upstream fixes, merged in. The search one is worth upgrading for if you have a
large `lat.md/`.

- **`lat search` is much faster on big corpora.** Indexing read each file once
  per section in it, so cost grew with sections times file size. It now reads
  each file once. On a 13k-section corpus a query went from 94 seconds to 3.7
  seconds, with the same results.

- **Fixed: documents overflowed the screen in `lat view` on a phone.** The
  mobile header also drew a doubled border, and the collapsed table of contents
  is laid out better.

- **Link underlines and table-of-contents state markers look right.** Underlines
  are consistent across rendered links, and the compact table of contents insets
  its state markers.

- **The release and CI workflows moved off the Node 20 runtime.** GitHub is
  removing the fallback that was keeping them working. Nothing changes for you;
  it keeps the fork's own builds running.

## Upgrading

```
npm i -g --prefix ~/.local/lat https://github.com/PlebeianTech/lat.md/releases/latest/download/lat.md-latest.tgz
```
